data.long_meaning: The name Hrushikesh is derived from the Sanskrit words ‘hrushi’ (god) and ‘kesh’ (in the heart). This name signifies the presence of the deity within an individual's heart. It is a revered name in Hindu tradition. The name Hrushikesh carries the meaning “God in the heart” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Hrushikesh usually hope their child will grow to embody god in the heart and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Hrushikesh belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “God in the heart.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Hrushikesh total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
